test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Venkat spends 65% of his income and is able to save Rs. 1,100 per month. His monthly expenses (correct up to two decimals) are:
solution:
GIVEN:

Expenditure 65% of his income and saving is Rs1100 per month

CONCEPT USED:

Income = Expenditure + Saving

CALCULATION:

Expenditure 65% of Income

Expenditure = (13/20)Income
